2609.09124.title: Canonical Color as a Lens into Concept Decodability in Vision Encoders and VLMs
2609.09124.paper_summary: Visual encoders construct a representation of the image input for Vision-Language models. How much conceptual, as opposed to immediately visible, information does this representation contain? We use canonical color as a controlled test case to ask whether vision encoders make canonical-color information linearly accessible, even when color is removed from the input image. We construct a dataset of objects with canonical colors, and probe vision encoders for both color and object identity using color and grayscale images. We find that canonical color remains decodable from grayscale images, and is tied to predicted object identity, indicating a conceptual link. Extending this analysis to full VLMs, we find that VLM post-training can have a surprisingly large effect on color decodability in the vision encoder. Overall, canonical color provides a usefully controllable lens for tracing object-level conceptual semantic information in vision encoders and VLMs.
2609.09124.paper_summary_zh: 視覺編碼器為視覺-語言模型構建圖像輸入的表示。這個表示包含多少概念性的信息，而不是立即可見的信息？我們使用典型顏色作為受控測試案例，來詢問視覺編碼器是否能夠線性地訪問典型顏色信息，即使在輸入圖像中移除顏色的情況下。我們構建了一個包含典型顏色物體的數據集，並使用彩色和灰階圖像探查視覺編碼器的顏色和物體身份。我們發現，典型顏色仍然可以從灰階圖像中解碼，並且與預測的物體身份相關，顯示出一種概念上的聯繫。將這一分析擴展到完整的 VLM，我們發現 VLM 的後訓練對視覺編碼器中的顏色可解碼性有著意想不到的巨大影響。總體而言，典型顏色為追踪視覺編碼器和 VLM 中的物體級概念語義信息提供了一個有用的可控視角。
